text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq achieves good results in last year's harvest campaign; increase of 460 per cent in corn yields, 600 per cent in cotton, 12 in rice and 15 in wheat and barley over previous year's figures.
- Budget revenues reach 224 billion dinars in 1996.
- British magazine Economist says Iraq among fastest-growing countries.
- Jordan says no political constraints attached to oil deal with Iraq.
- War of threats between Moscow and Ankara.
- Industry and minerals minister meets Moroccan ambassador.
- Civil defence teams defuse 352,000 bombs dropped by allies during 1991 Gulf War.
- Endowments and religious affairs minister meets Egyptian religious dignitaries.
- (The above were also carried by AL-THAWRA and JUMHOURIYA).
